name: enterprise-transport-platform
description: npm workspaces root. Exists solely so the shared UI libraries (consumed as TypeScript source, no build step) can resolve @angular/core, @angular/forms, react, react-dom etc. from a node_modules directory that is an ANCESTOR of both the library and the consuming app. Without this, apps/shared-ui-library/angular and apps/shared-ui-library/react are siblings of the apps that import them, and Node's module resolution can never walk up to a sibling's node_modules — that mismatch was the root cause of the 'Cannot find module @angular/core' build failure in the Client Portal.
